# A // in a string, in a raw string or in a triple-quoted string does not
# start a comment, and a comment after such a string is still found.
celfmt -i raw.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_raw.txt

celfmt -i escape.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_escape.txt

celfmt -i quote.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_quote.txt

celfmt -i triple.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_triple.txt

celfmt -i triple_colon.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_triple_colon.txt

celfmt -i triple_paren.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_triple_paren.txt


# A comment is written once when there is text that is not ASCII before it.
celfmt -i nonascii.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_nonascii.txt


# A comment after the question mark is found when the condition has a call
# that spans lines.
celfmt -i call_cond.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_call_cond.txt

celfmt -i call_and.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_call_and.txt

celfmt -i call_arg.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_call_arg.txt


# A comment after a literal with text that is more than one byte for each
# character is kept, also when it has been formatted before.
celfmt -i multibyte.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_multibyte.txt

celfmt -i multibyte_map.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_multibyte_map.txt

celfmt -i multibyte_space.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_multibyte_space.txt

celfmt -i multibyte_mixed.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_multibyte_mixed.txt



# The comment after an opening bracket is found when there is text that is
# not ASCII before it.
celfmt -i open_rune.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_open_rune.txt



# The prefixes of a raw bytes literal can be in either case, a quote can
# follow a triple quote, and a blank line in a triple-quoted string is not a
# blank line of the program.
celfmt -i bytes_upper.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_bytes_upper.txt

celfmt -i quad_quote.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_quad_quote.txt

celfmt -i triple_blank.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_triple_blank.txt

-- raw.cel --
state.x.as(a, r"\" + "//x" + a
+ "y"
)
-- want_raw.txt --
state.x.as(a,
	"\\" + "//x" + a + "y"
)
-- escape.cel --
state.x.as(a, "a\"" + a // real
+ "y"
)
-- want_escape.txt --
state.x.as(a, // real
	"a\"" + a + "y"
)
-- quote.cel --
state.x.as(a, 'it // is' + a // real
+ "y"
)
-- want_quote.txt --
state.x.as(a, // real
	"it // is" + a + "y"
)
-- triple.cel --
size(
"""// nc
"""
)
-- want_triple.txt --
size(
	"// nc\n"
)
-- triple_colon.cel --
state.a ?
	"""x
: // nc
"""
: // real
	"1"
-- want_triple_colon.txt --
state.a ?
	"x\n: // nc\n"
: // real
	"1"
-- triple_paren.cel --
[
"""
) // nc
""",
]
-- want_triple_paren.txt --
[
	"""
) // nc
""",
]
-- nonascii.cel --
{"é": state.a, "b": [ // c
	1,
]}
-- want_nonascii.txt --
{
	"é": state.a, // c
	"b": [
		1,
	],
}
-- call_cond.cel --
(state.a.contains(
"") ? state.b : state.c) ? // c1
state.d : state.e
-- want_call_cond.txt --
(state.a.contains(
	""
) ? state.b : state.c) ? // c1
	state.d
:
	state.e
-- call_and.cel --
(state.a.contains(
"") && state.c) ? // c1
state.d : state.e
-- want_call_and.txt --
(state.a.contains(
	""
) && state.c) ? // c1
	state.d
:
	state.e
-- call_arg.cel --
state.a.contains(
"") ? // c1
state.d : state.e
-- want_call_arg.txt --
state.a.contains(
	""
) ? // c1
	state.d
:
	state.e
-- multibyte.cel --
[
	"日本", // c
	1,
]
-- want_multibyte.txt --
[
	"日本", // c
	1,
]
-- multibyte_map.cel --
{
	"k": "ééé", // c
}
-- want_multibyte_map.txt --
{
	"k": "ééé", // c
}
-- multibyte_space.cel --
[
	"日本",   // c
	1,
]
-- want_multibyte_space.txt --
[
	"日本", // c
	1,
]
-- multibyte_mixed.cel --
{
"é": "日本", // c1
"b": state.a + "日本", // c2
"c": size("日本"), // c3
"d": ["é", "ü"], // c4
}
-- want_multibyte_mixed.txt --
{
	"é": "日本", // c1
	"b": state.a + "日本", // c2
	"c": size("日本"), // c3
	"d": ["é", "ü"], // c4
}
-- open_rune.cel --
{"é": [ // c
1,
]}
-- want_open_rune.txt --
{
	"é": [ // c
		1,
	],
}
-- bytes_upper.cel --
state.x.as(a, Br"\" + b"//x" + a // real
+ b"y"
)
-- want_bytes_upper.txt --
state.x.as(a, // real
	b"\134" + b"\057\057\170" + a + b"\171"
)
-- quad_quote.cel --
[
''''  x''', // c
1,
]
-- want_quad_quote.txt --
[
	"'  x", // c
	1,
]
-- triple_blank.cel --
[
"""a

b""" + "c",
]
-- want_triple_blank.txt --
[
	"a\n\nb" + "c",
]
